paragraphs: Hyman cites Shabbat 25a for his statement in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.[^2] He also cites [Taanit 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.24b.10) according to Ein Yaakov, while his own text reads R’ Nachman bar Ushpazti.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Taanit text names Rav Nachman bar Ushpazti when he addresses Rav Papa. The specific Ein Yaakov reading and the attribution in Shabbat 25a remain unconfirmed. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2694&lang=en) refers the reader to Natan bar Oshaya.

In [Shabbat 65a:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.65a.5), Rav Nachman bar Oshaya says in Rabbi Yochanan’s name that the cloth is permitted if the woman made a handgrip for it. Hyman gives 25a for this transmission. The Ushpazti reading in Taanit is a separate occurrence.
